name: Cody Cox
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/664ecd69214be8c0bdca83860a9ad6f5.jpg
reason: It is him, and it is a good photograph, and it is still not his portrait. It was made for the Herald's February 2014 feature on gay students at WKU and has nothing to do with his service in student government. Withdrawn once already and re-found by a later researcher who did not know. Do not publish it.

name: Drew Mitchell
file: Herald 12 Oct 2010, p.6, mugshot captioned MITCHELL
reason: The caption gives a surname and nothing else. Mitchell is far too common to pin a face on, and no other evidence ties this frame to the Drew Mitchell who served.

name: Paige Pride
file: 1991 Talisman, p. 119, underclassmen portraits (McF-Poy), the cell printed 'Susan P. Pride, Tell City, Ind.'
reason: The 1991 index carries exactly one Pride in the whole volume and the timing is right, but the printed name is Susan P. Pride and nothing in the archive gives Paige Pride a first name of Susan. A middle-initial match is not an identification. Do not cut this face until a source gives her full name; the ASG minutes only ever call her Paige, and once Page.
resolved: Settled 1 September 2026, and settled without using the 1991 cell. The 1993 Talisman carries exactly one Pride, indexed "Pride, Paige 42, 156, 188, 192, 203". Page 203 captions a photograph "Paige Pride, a senior from Tell City, Ind., tries to wash off Brian Lomax", and the senior class portrait grid on p. 42 that the same index entry points at prints "S. Paige Pride, Biochemistry, Tell City, Ind." The portrait published for her is that 1993 p. 42 cell, not the 1991 p. 119 cell described above, which remains unused. The 1991 cell's Susan P. Pride of Tell City, Ind. is now evidently the same woman, but no claim rests on it.

name: Todd Wallace
file: 1984 Talisman, p. 150, the class portrait indexed as 'Wallace, Michael Todd 150'
reason: A different person. The 1985 Talisman indexes the Todd Wallace who served in Congress as Todd David Wallace, pages 79, 80, 224 and 273, and page 79 quotes him as a Cadiz senior. Michael Todd Wallace is a second student. The 1984 entry looks like the obvious match and is not.

name: Kelly S. Smith
file: 1984 Talisman, p. 147, the class portrait indexed as 'Smith, Kelly Annette 147, 268'
reason: The only Kelly Smith in the 1984 index, and page 268 is an organization page rather than the Associated Student Government spread on 238, so nothing ties her to ASG. The archive's treasurer is Kelly S. Smith and this index entry gives Annette as the middle name. Smith is far too common to place a face on a mismatched initial.

name: David Bass
file: 1978 Talisman, p. 34, top right photograph of an ASG meeting
reason: The caption reads: A LIGHT MOMENT IN AN ASG MEETING brings laughter from president Bob Moore and smiles from activities vice president David Bass, secretary Sharon May and vice president Cathy Murphy. Four people are in the frame and the laughing man is plainly Moore, but the caption gives no positions for the other three, one of them is turned away with no face visible, and the remaining two cannot be told apart by sex at this print quality: the foreground figure in sunglasses has the feathered shoulder-length hair of either. It is the only picture in the 1977-81 volumes that names Bass at all, and his index entry gives him no class portrait page, so a later researcher will find this frame and be tempted. Do not use it without a source that says who is where.

name: Horace Johnson
file: any Herald 1995-1999 photograph or mention captioned Horace Johnson
reason: Every Horace Johnson in the Herald across these years is the WKU campus police chief, not a student. Herald 71:48, 28 March 1996 p. 6 has "Chief Horace Johnson said the bike patrol has been a tremendous success"; Herald 71:51, 9 April 1996 p. 2 has "Police Chief Horace Johnson" swearing in new officers; and the paper covered his resignation as chief on 4 March 1999. The archive lists an SGA officer of this name in 1995-96 with no title. Do not attach the chief to the student without a source that puts a Horace Johnson in a student seat.

name: Antonina Clementi
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/SGASessionTwo_22.jpg
reason: The caption positions her correctly - 'Speaker of the Senate Julie Mishchuk (right) and Secretary of the Senate Antonina Clementi (left) pack up' - and the right-hand figure matches the archive's existing portrait of Mishchuk, so the identification is sound. The problem is the frame: the left-hand figure is cut off above the shoulders and no part of her face is in the picture. It is the most tempting caption in the block and it contains no face.

name: Antonina Clementi
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/download.png
reason: The WKU forensics team award photograph of April 2022, carried in _herald-leads.json. Its caption is fully positioned and puts Clementi first in the front row left to right, so it would identify her. But the file the Herald published is 640x428 for twenty-six people, every one of them masked, and a head is about twenty-four pixels across. There is no face to cut and upscaling is forbidden.

name: Annalise Finch
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/ER12048.jpg
reason: Her only Herald photograph and the caption names her alone: 'Elementary education major and Executive Vice President of SGA, Annalise Finch, takes a selfie with her class pet'. She is photographed from behind and to one side with her arm raised to the phone; the frame shows the back of her head and hair and no face at all. Checked at full resolution before rejecting.

name: Harper Anderson
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/6a32adf19a30fadd29c4418d6c682e0a.jpg
reason: 'WKU Student Body President elect Stephen Mayer hugs his administrative vice president Harper Anderson after hearing that their ticket won the SGA election.' Two named people and the archive already holds a portrait of Mayer, so which figure is Anderson is not in doubt. She has her face buried in his shoulder with her back to the camera and nothing of her face shows. The duplicate upload of 2019-03-27 is the same file.

name: Hannah Neeper
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/7acb7747154cad4e475308f8bf1d9288.jpg
reason: 'Student President Jay Todd Richey, left hugs Administrative Vice President Hannah Neeper, and Executive Vice President Kate Hart hugs Colton Hushell after the SGA results announcement.' Four named people in two hugging pairs and the positions do resolve, but Neeper is the woman with her back to the camera in the left pair and her face is not in the frame. Flagged in 2011-2015-notes.json as a lead needing a crop; it cannot be cropped. The 2016-04-21 upload is the same file.

name: Murphy Burke
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/832757b7c6f1bceff1047b9c64c097b0.jpg
reason: The presidential search committee student forum of 27 April 2016. The caption names Higdon, Richey and Burch left, middle and right at the table and describes them answering 'sophomore, Murphy Burke's question'. name: Cain Alvey
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/03/c2c44efe98edd2239bc31cee48c13c0f-1.jpg
reason: The SGA election results frame of 30 March 2012. Its caption names Cory Dodds, Cain Alvey and Keyana Boka and gives no positions for any of them, and at least six people are in the picture. 2011-2015-notes.json lists it as a lead that 'needs a crop', and it cannot honestly be cropped: nothing in the caption or the article says where Alvey is standing. The archive already publishes the whole uncropped frame as its photograph of Cory Dodds.

name: Mark Clark
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/7f3c1736182c67bb68f5ca55389f3e36.jpg
reason: 'Junior Mark Clark and freshman Kat Tyler work in the new Pride Center relocated in Downing Student Union room 2084.' Two people, two names, no positions, and nothing visual separates a junior from a freshman. Both have short dark hair, both are laughing with a hand raised to the face, and at this size neither can be told apart by sex. This is the David Bass problem again. The 2018-04-13 upload is the same file. Separately, a later researcher should weigh whether a photograph made inside the Pride Center is the right portrait for someone whose service is the point, given that a portrait was already withdrawn from this archive for that reason.

name: Noah Moore
file: https://wkuherald.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/3a24da74bc091f493a48dadc637123b4.jpg
reason: Captioned 'Tour guide Noah Moore' and it is a clean studio portrait, which is why it keeps being re-found; it is now in _herald-leads.json as well. It is the wrong Noah Moore. WKU has two in these years and the tour guide is Noah Moore of Fort Thomas, a public relations, Spanish and Arabic major, class of 2021, Sigma Phi Epsilon, whose WKU write-up lists five campus offices and does not include SGA. The SGA Noah Moore was elected a junior senator in April 2018. The Sigma Phi Epsilon group frame of 2018-04-09 is the same wrong man. Reasoning first recorded in modern-b-notes.json.

name: Rachel Keightley
file: https://www.wku.edu/english/alumni-profiles/keightley-dudgeon-2019.pdf, the portrait on page 1
reason: A different person. The WKU English department's alumni profile is of Keightley Dudgeon, class of 2019, and Keightley is her given name; the profile never mentions student government. WKU's own autumn 2015 dean's and president's list for the Bowling Green area prints the SGA member as Rachel A. Keightley, with an Andrew B. Keightley at the same postcode. A first name against a surname is not a match. This is the first thing a search for Keightley on wku.edu returns, so it will be found again.

name: Anne Guillory
file: Herald 71:59, 2 May 1996, p. 2, the photograph above the caption naming her at the regents meeting
reason: The caption names her alone and the identification is sound, but the frame is unusable as a portrait. She is lit from behind with her hand over her mouth and the whole head reads as a black silhouette: 85 per cent of the pixels across the face fall below tone 40 in the scan, and a level stretch recovers nothing but the outline of the fingers. A second person sits fully blacked out at the left edge. There is no face in it to publish.

name: Ryan Faught
file: Herald 73:7, 16 September 1997, p. 3, the new Spirit Masters photograph in front of Cherry Hall
reason: Five men are named in the caption and five are visible, but the caption gives no positions and says outright that they stand in a circle, so the printed order carries no left-to-right guarantee. The one usable test fails: Josh Detre is fourth in the name list, and the only face in the frame that resembles his verified 1998 portrait is the third figure from the left. Four of the five faces are in near darkness at a midnight exposure in any case. Ryan Faught cannot be picked out of it, and neither can anyone else.

name: Jeff Oliver
file: Herald 73:9, 23 September 1997, p. 1, the march in support of Valerie Haskins
reason: The caption reads left to right and names three marchers, ending with Bowling Green senior Jeff Oliver, so on its face it places him at the right. It does not survive the frame. Two capped figures walk almost shoulder to shoulder at the right edge, one behind the other, and more people walk behind the banner, so the caption cannot say which body is the third named person. The 7 November 1996 Young Democrats frame is the one to use for him: there the caption anchors him with the single word left against three clear foreground subjects.

name: Danny Creasy, Bill Livingston, Marshall Florence, Gayle Sharp, John Tuttle
file: 1972 Talisman, p. 273, the standing ranks of the Associated Students men's group photograph
reason: The caption gives Row 2 seven names and Row 3 five, and twelve men stand behind the table, so the count is right. The ranks are not. They stand interleaved at two depths in a single crowd with no gap between them, and head height does not sort them: several men in the nominal back rank stand level with men in front. The check that ought to settle it fails as well. Three Black men stand in the group, where the caption puts two in Row 2, George Kendrick and Robert Scales, and one in Row 3, Ed Givens; the archive now holds class portraits of all three and the tallest man in the photograph wears glasses, which none of the portraits does. Only Row 1, the four men seated at the table, reads cleanly, and Terry Miller has been cut from it. Do not cut Creasy, Livingston, Florence, Sharp or Tuttle from the standing ranks without a source that says who is where.
